album.title: The Mirza Abdollah Radif for Tar and Setar, Vol. 7

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ak3 and dwells most on Ak in Oshshaq. The line peaks at C5 (518.5 Hz) at 1:45.1. It closes on C5, not the tonic (C4 → G3 → C5 → C5 → C5 → C5).

flags: tonic F set in the catalog (the Rast-Panjgah suite's finalis F: Daramad II and ten gushe-ha end on it; read from it the suite has Rast's leading tone (the 2nd below, 4% of played time), which the other candidate, its 5th C, lacks (0.3%); Farhat 1990, pp. 100-101. Borumand's Nava on the same volume sits a tone above it, as in Farhat's keys; the vote picked the 5th. Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 517.9 Hz (C)

p04 (A): E2 window sizes disagree by 11 ¢ {4096: 389.96, 8192: 400.81}; the shorter window reads lower: a string ringing near the note pulls the shorter window toward it, short notes blur the longer one
